case_name: Mrs. Asha Sharma v Chandigarh Administration & Ors
holding: The State shall not allot two different houses to one government servant.
No case of retention of government accommodation beyond the periods specified in the table to Rule 13(2) of the Allotment Rules shall be entertained by any authority under the Allotment Rules.
The authorities are directed not to take recourse to Rule 13(5) of the Allotment Rules under any circumstance.
